title: The monument-attribution posture
statement: The corpus's posture toward the alternative-archaeology complex — lost-builder attributions, monument redatings, astronomical-alignment theses (the Orion correlation and the Sphinx redating as the strongest cases), and sacred-geometry readings — is per-site registration at each thesis's own grade, with mainstream archaeology's accounts and the skeptical archaeoastronomy controls carried in full; no site or alignment is evidence for the framework, whose chronology (woh-claim-0003) stands on its own anchors and leans on no redating.

includes: Per-site discipline: each thesis carried at its own grade in its own entry (the Orion correlation and Sphinx redating as inferred registrations of external theses; lost-builder generalizations and sacred-geometry as speculative), never merged into one 'ancient mysteries' mass

The controls carried in full: mainstream archaeology's dating and construction accounts, and the skeptical archaeoastronomy literature (Krupp's critiques above all), preserved at strength on every site
The independence declaration, which is the posture's point: the corpus's chronology stands on the precessional anchors of woh-claim-0003 and would survive the failure of every thesis in this cluster
Where a thesis touches the corpus's age-lattice (a Leo-era monument reading), the touch is registered as consonance, never as support
excludes: Any site, alignment, or redating as evidence for the framework
Endorsement of the alternative-archaeology genre's methods or its lost-civilization narratives
Construction-impossibility arguments, which the corpus does not make
Adjudication of ongoing excavation disputes; the entries register, the diggers decide

source_references.locator: The correlation thesis at its own strength
The skeptical archaeoastronomy control carried against the alignment theses
The canon's own monument references, at the canon's level, which the posture keeps separate from the external theses

alternatives.statement: Registering the genre's strongest cases at inferred grade still lends them the corpus's platform; distance-with-coverage is coverage.
Mainstream archaeology's accounts are complete; the cluster deserves no registration at all, and carrying it reflects audience appetite rather than evidential judgment.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0003 is revised or retired.
A registered thesis is decisively resolved in either direction — the entry moves, and consonance claims move with it.
Public prose begins citing a site as support or making construction-impossibility arguments, both of which this record excludes.
